gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all available fields in Jira to understand what data can be captured for my projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all fields including their IDs, names, and types.

gold.user: As a product owner, I need to create a custom field to capture specific user feedback in our Jira issues.
gold.ideal: Creates a new custom field with the specified parameters and returns the created field's details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to fetch fields in a paginated manner to efficiently handle large sets of data.
gold.ideal: Returns a paginated list of fields with options for page size and current page.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to view trashed fields to decide which ones to restore or permanently delete.
gold.ideal: Returns a paginated list of trashed fields with their details.

gold.user: As a project lead, I need to update the configuration of an existing custom field to better suit our workflow.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified custom field and returns the updated field's details.

gold.user: As a business analyst, I want to retrieve the contexts associated with a specific field to analyze its usage.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of contexts for the specified field, including context IDs and names.

gold.user: As a product manager, I want to delete a custom field that is no longer needed to keep our Jira clean.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified custom field and confirms the deletion.

gold.user: As a system admin, I need to restore a previously deleted custom field that is still relevant for our projects.
